extraction_notes: The ES2JF target column is the 600 V variant in the ES2AF through ES2JF family table.

Maximum ratings for ES2JF on p. 1: VRRM = 600 V, VRMS = 420 V, VDC = 600 V, IF(AV) = 2.0 A at 60 Hz sinewave with resistance load and TL per Fig. 1, IFSM = 50.0 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine wave, Tstg = -55 to +150 degC, Tj = -55 to +150 degC, RthetaJ-A = 65 degC/W, and RthetaJ-L = 20 degC/W.
The five curve points are direct digitizations of visible ES2JF dotted-curve crossings at the 0.001 A, 0.01 A, 0.1 A, 1 A, and 10 A decade lines in Fig. 3; no interpolation was used.
The separate IR2 maximum is 0.0001 A at VR = VDC = 600 V and TA = 125 degC; IR1 at 25 degC is the reverse_current field.
No breakdown voltage or breakdown current characteristic is published for this rectifier variant.
